description.value: Switch is a bar and karaoke venue on Vancouver's Robson Street offering private karaoke suites, a food menu, and a drink menu. Located in the heart of the West End, it draws a lively evening crowd. The venue is wheelchair accessible per OSM tags and sits on one of Vancouver's most walkable and cyclable commercial corridors.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 35m; stands (5 spaces) at 41m; stands (2 spaces) at 48m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Switch is a bar, karaoke, and private suites venue at 1339 Robson St, Vancouver BC V6E 2B1, consistent with the OSM address. The website reveals a phone number (604.264.7026) not present in OSM tags. No cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so bike parking, water refill, washrooms, and all optional amenities remain null.
concerns: OSM has no phone number recorded; website lists 604-264-7026, used as the top-level phone value.
Two PDF subpages (dinner menus) returned 404 Not Found, suggesting some website content may be outdated, though the main listing page is current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Switch is a real, operating bar and entertainment venue on Robson Street with an active website and confirmed address; useful to touring cyclists as a food and drink stop.

wow_evidence: bar and karaoke venue on Vancouver's Robson Street offering private karaoke suites
